newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Small investors help push Dhaka stocks higher.
newsitem.headline: Small investors help push Dhaka stocks higher.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher in active buying by small investors, especially in the engineering sector, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed 16.78 points, or 0.88 percent, up at 1,922.37 on turnover of 73.7 million taka.
"The market was active. Investor confidence remained high as buyers came back seeing the upward trend of share prices," said one broker.
Singer Bangladesh gained 119 taka to 12,800, Amam Sea Food Industries rose 22 to 4,040 and Reckitt & Colman fell 12.5 to 269.69. -- Dhaka Newsroom+880-2-506363
